provenance_note: Different labels denote different identities. The frozen BUNDLE_META.source_tree value equals starting_working_tree_baseline, NOT archive_source_content_tree. A future corrected bundle must emit labelled fields, not a bare source_tree.

semantics.archive_source_content_tree: Content-tree digest computed from the bytes of SOURCE/ members inside a zip archive. This is the only digest that answers 'what source does this bundle ship?'.
semantics.archive_zip_file: SHA-256 of the archive file itself. Identifies the container bytes, not the tree of its contents.
semantics.git_head_tree_object: Git tree object id of HEAD (40 hex). Enumerates git-tracked objects only; excludes dirty working-tree changes and ignores exclusion sets.
semantics.starting_working_tree_baseline: Content-tree digest of the pre-remediation RC working copy recorded by rc_setup.py; baseline for the remediation diff. It is NOT the identity of any shipped archive content.
semantics.working_tree_standardized: Content-tree digest of a working copy using EX_STANDARDIZED (regression/ excluded). This is the identity the RC/Sprint 'SOURCE/' bundle trees use.
